points.description: States that the star (*) operator is the dereferencing operator and returns the object/value that its operand (a pointer/address) points to in memory (an alias for that object).
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks for a related but incomplete statement, e.g. says it gives the value at an address or is the dereference operator without saying what is returned, or says it relates to pointers only vaguely.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying in any wording that * returns the object or value the pointer points to (the thing at that address), or that it dereferences a pointer. Part marks for vague or half-right answers, such as only naming it a pointer operator or dereferencing without saying what comes back. No marks if the answer is unrelated, such as saying it multiplies only or returns the address itself.
